Companion deck · Module 3 · Day 3 · Slides 24 to 26

Five posts.

The set participants analyse in the closing exercise. Same five every workshop so cohorts can be compared. Update annually as the source material dates.
The five types, in order
01 Genuine 02 Distorted 03 Imposter 04 AI-generated 05 Heuristic
Runtime
8 slides · ~15 minutes
Small groups · phones out · one shared debrief
The four-step task
02 / 08
For each post, in this order

Four steps. Then present one.

01
Apply CRAAP.
All five letters. Quick, but completely. Currency, Relevance, Authority, Accuracy, Purpose.
02
Triangulate.
Independent sources. Different owners, different editorial angles, different reporting paths.
03
Spot the heuristic.
Familiarity, authority, social proof, emotional resonance. Which shortcut is the post leaning on?
04
Check for AI.
Text patterns. Image artefacts. Video tells. Voice-cloning cues. Reverse-search where you can.
Then
Each group presents one post · findings, disagreements, "where we weren't sure".

0:47
8,412 replies 24,208 reposts 42,891 likes 3.2M views
Category revealed after debrief
Voice cloning has become undetectable to casual listeners in 2026 — documented in Africa Check & Dubawa teardowns of Nigerian election-cycle audio "leaks". Account and framing are fabricated. Listen closely: the audio is routine business (quarterly report, committee meeting) — not the fuel-subsidy conversation the post claims. That's the lesson: framing does the deception; the tell is the mismatch between what the caption asserts and what the recording actually says.

Answer key

Putting it all together

The five, revealed.

POST · 01
Genuine, verified
Tells: verified institutional handle, primary-source link, sober language, realistic engagement for boring news. CRAAP clean.
POST · 02
Verified account, distorted claim
Tells: real-looking verified account plus a quote pulled out of context. Triangulate against the original speech transcript to catch it.
POST · 03
Imposter account
Tells: handle has underscore (real: @PremiumTimesng), URL is .ng not .com, no verified badge, anonymous "sources", clickbait language.
POST · 04
AI-generated audio
Tells: anonymous source, no other outlet reporting it, no original broadcast to compare against. Voice-cloning is undetectable to casual listeners — provenance is the check.
POST · 05
Heuristic exploitation
Tells: conspiracy framing, all-caps, emoji urgency, anonymous "doctors", no citations, viral engagement. All four heuristics at once.
